findings.reason: the section's own shape test already refuses to split a sha-plus-subject entry (the subject is not an entry-shaped token), so including `commits` costs nothing and removes the stated boundary from a false premise; as written a worker keeps a defect the census the section mandates will report but the plan then tells it not to fix.
findings.text: the widened rule stops at the three guarded path fields, justified by "`commits` keeps its present reading, because its entries are written as a sha followed by a subject"; that population claim is false — real manifests write several shas on one `commits:` line, e.g. `r-20261016T084145210091-equilibrium-hygiene` (four shas, and again three), `r-20261020T155135888398-cbl-wiring-diverted-render` (six, and again one), `r-20261007T032825749037-promotion-keeps-every-round` (two), `r-20261024T142016415225-edit-and-response-shape-tests-read-the-returned-shapes` (four) — and `_coerce_commit_identifiers` reads each line as one entry, which `_require_commits_beyond_base` (promotion_evidence.py:276–280) then passes whole to `_commit_canonical_id`: that resolves no revision for an entry holding two shas, returns `None`, and the loop `continue`s — so every sha on such a line is dropped from the base-citation and ancestry checks without a word. That is the silent-misread this section exists to remove, and the reason `commits` is in `_GUARDED_LIST_KEYS` (reports.py:97–108)

findings.reason: without a case for it the section's gate cannot distinguish "the rule is applied to all three declared fields" from "the loop was widened and the third field was silently skipped", and the omitted field is precisely the one outside the existing loop.
findings.text: `orientation_write_paths` is named in the deliverable's field list but has no case among the eight, and it is the one field of the three that `_MANIFEST_LIST_KEYS` (reports.py:85–94) omits, so the coercion loop at reports.py:870 does not reach it and it needs a call of its own, and an implementation that widens only the existing loop passes all eight cases while leaving a third of the declared rule unbuilt
